description_en: Retrieves the list of ECS instances under the current user's VPC and vSwitch
description_zh: 获取当前用户vpc和vswitch下的ECS 实例列表
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch list-ecs-instances --page 1 --size 10 --ecs-instance-ids '["i-bp13y63575oypr9d****","i-bp1gyhphjaj73jsr****"]' --ecs-instance-name test --tags '[{"tagKey":"a","tagValue":"b"}]' --vpc-id vpc-bp16k1dvzxtmagcva0000 --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListEcsInstances

parameters.help_en: The page number of the returned results. Maximum value: 500
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of results per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 500
parameters.help_zh: 每页包含的结果数。默认值10，最大值500
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en: The list of ECS instance IDs. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 instance IDs separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: ECS实例ID列表。取值可以由多个实例ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: ecs_instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
The ECS instance tags. The following fields must be included:

tagKey: the tag key.
tagValue: the tag value
parameters.help_zh:
ECS实例标签，必须包含：

tagKey：标签键
tagValue：标签值
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID of the ECS instance
parameters.name: vpc_id
